parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

parameters.name: VSwitchIds
parameters.description: List of specified vSwitches connected to the network access endpoint.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: VPC ID connected to the network access endpoint.

parameters.name: VpcRegionId
parameters.description: Region of the VPC ID connected to the network access endpoint.
